dataset.description:
Dataset of input variables for fire hazard estimation in Cabañeros National Park (Spain), derived from PNOA LiDAR data and processed using FlamMap software. The dataset is complemented by Víctor Cuevas' Master's thesis, which provides an in-depth explanation of the main results. This research is part of the project INFORICAM (PID2020-119402RB- I00), funded by the Agencia Estatal de Investigación MCIN/AEI/10.13039/501100011033 and by the European Union.
